name: Konomi Kohara
bio: Konomi Kohara (小原 好美, Kohara Konomi) is a Japanese voice actress affiliated with Office Osawa. She debuted as a voice actress in 2016 and started to get main roles in 2017.

credits.title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend
credits.overview: Faced with the truth about Miori and Touko Kirishima, Sakuta must make a choice. This will be his final case of Adolescence Syndrome!
